excludedFile.title: Add file path
excludedFile.help: Enter a path or a regular expression, e.g. /daily-.*/

excludedTag.title: Add tag
excludedTag.help: Enter a tag or a regular expression, e.g. /^draft/

excludedProperty.title: Add property
excludedProperty.nameHelp: Enter a property name or a regular expression, e.g. /^status/
excludedProperty.valueHelp: Enter a property value or a regular expression, e.g. /draft|wip/, or leave blank to match all notes with the property name above.

editor.name: Settings JSON
editor.desc: Only settings that differ from the defaults are included.

file.name: Settings file
file.desc: Select a settings file to load it into the editor below.

editor.name: Settings JSON
editor.desc: Paste a settings file here, or edit the loaded one before importing.

confirm.title: Caution
confirm.message: This replaces every plugin setting. Any setting missing from the file returns to its default. A backup of your current settings is saved to your vault first.

errors.invalidFile: Invalid settings file. Please select a valid JSON file.
errors.incompatibleVersion: This settings file comes from an incompatible plugin version. Your current settings were left unchanged.
errors.backupFailed: Your current settings could not be backed up. Nothing was imported.

renameAutomatically.name: Rename automatically
renameAutomatically.desc: Rename open notes automatically when edited. Turn this off to only rename via commands.

renameOnFocus.name: Rename on focus
renameOnFocus.desc: Also rename notes when they become active in the editor.

onlyRenameIfHeading.name: Rename only if heading
onlyRenameIfHeading.desc: Don't rename notes if the first line is not a heading.

moveCursorToFirstLine.name: Move cursor to first line
moveCursorToFirstLine.desc: Place the cursor in the first line on note creation, unless excluded.

placeCursorAtLineEnd.name: Place cursor at line end
placeCursorAtLineEnd.desc: When moving the cursor to a first line with content, place it at the end of the line instead of the start.

insertTitle.name: Insert title
insertTitle.desc: Place the file name in the first line when creating an empty note, unless excluded or named {{untitled}}.

convertReplacementChars.name: Convert replacement characters
convertReplacementChars.desc: When inserting the title on note creation, convert replacements for forbidden characters back to their original forms, as set in {{section}} settings.

formatAsHeading.name: Format as heading
formatAsHeading.desc: When inserting the title on note creation, make it a heading.

renameOnSave.name: Rename on save
renameOnSave.desc: Rename notes on manual save (Ctrl/Cmd-S on desktop by default) unless excluded.

renameAllNotes.name: Rename all notes
renameAllNotes.desc: Rename every note in the vault.

discuss.name: Discuss
discuss.desc: View discussions or ask a question.

exclusions.desc: Exclude files, tags and properties from renaming.
exclusions.note: Note: A note will not be renamed if any rule excludes it even if another rule allows renaming it. For example, a note in an excluded folder will not be renamed even if it has a tag that allows renaming.

files.title: Files
files.renamedWarning: Renamed, moved or deleted files and folders are not reflected below. Update manually if paths change.

tags.title: Tags
tags.excludeAllNote: {{option}} also excludes notes with no tags.
tags.tagWranglerWarning: Renamed tags are not reflected below. Update manually after renaming.

matchSubtags.name: Match subtags
matchSubtags.desc: For example, also match #work/projects if #work is listed below.

properties.title: Properties
properties.excludeAllNote: {{option}} also excludes notes with no properties.
properties.renamedWarning: Renamed properties aren't reflected below. Update manually after renaming.

disableProperty.title: Property that disables renaming
disableProperty.alwaysRespected: Always respected — cannot get overridden by any command.
disableProperty.updateWarning: Changing this will not automatically update properties that have been previously added to notes. Update manually after changing.

firstLineProperty.desc: Copy the first line to a property when renaming.

propertyName.name: First line property
propertyName.desc: The name of the property to copy the first line to when renaming.
propertyName.quickSwitcher: Use “aliases” to make the first line searchable in the Quick switcher and link suggestions.
propertyName.multipleProperties: To populate multiple properties, separate with commas.

addOnlyIfTitleDiffers.name: Add only if title differs from first line
addOnlyIfTitleDiffers.desc: Only fill the first line property if the first line and the title are not identical, for example, if the file name was truncated, or some characters have been replaced or removed.

truncate.name: Truncate
truncate.desc: In accordance with the {{setting}} value in {{section}} settings.

applyCustomReplacements.name: Apply custom replacements
applyCustomReplacements.desc: Apply custom text replacements to the first line property, as set in {{section}} settings.

stripMarkup.name: Strip markup
stripMarkup.desc: Omit markup syntax in the first line property, as set in {{section}} settings.

keepEmptyProperty.name: Keep empty property
keepEmptyProperty.desc: When the plugin removes the first line property value and no other values remain, keep the empty property rather than delete it.

placeLast.name: Place last in list
placeLast.desc: Place the first line property value last in a list-type property.

hideProperty.name: Hide property
hideProperty.desc: Hide the first line property in Reading view and Live Preview.

hideInSidebar.name: Hide in sidebar
hideInSidebar.desc: Also hide the property in the properties sidebar.

characterReplacements.name: Replace forbidden characters
characterReplacements.desc: Replace characters forbidden in the file name with safe alternatives.
characterReplacements.toggleDesc: Replace characters not allowed in Obsidian file names with safe alternatives. Turn this off to remove them entirely.

allOSes.title: All OSes
allOSes.desc: These characters are forbidden in Obsidian file names on every operating system.

windowsAndroid.title: Windows and Android
windowsAndroid.desc: These characters are forbidden in Obsidian file names on Windows and Android only.

dialog.trimLeftDesc: Remove spaces before the character in the file name.
dialog.trimRightDesc: Remove spaces after the character in the file name.

summary.keptExceptAtStart: Kept, except at the start of the file name

characters.backslashNote: Note: The backslash is replaced only when it's visible in Reading view.
characters.dotNote: Note: The dot is forbidden only at the start of the file name.
characters.question: Question mark ?

customReplacements.desc: Configure custom text replacements for the file name.
customReplacements.leaveBlank: Leave empty to omit the text entirely.
customReplacements.duplicate: Another rule already replaces this text

processingOrder.applyAfterForbidden: Apply after stripping or replacing forbidden characters

markupStripping.desc: Remove markup syntax in the file name.

stripHorizontalRuleMarkup.name: Strip horizontal rule markup
stripHorizontalRuleMarkup.desc: Instead, put the first line after the horizontal rule in the title.

codeBlocks.name: Strip code block markup
codeBlocks.desc: Instead, put the first line within the code block in the title.

detectDiagrams.name: Detect diagrams
detectDiagrams.desc: For Mermaid diagram blocks, put {{standIn}} in the title.

commentsEntirely.name: Strip comments entirely
commentsEntirely.desc: Omit comment content in the title.

commands.desc: Set which plugin commands appear in context menus.

file.name: Show file commands
file.desc: Show plugin commands in the file context menu.

folder.name: Show folder commands
folder.desc: Show plugin commands in the folder context menu.

tag.name: Show tag commands
tag.desc: Show plugin commands in the tag context menu.

search.name: Show search commands
search.desc: Show plugin commands in the vault search context menu.

charCount.name: Character count
charCount.desc: The maximum number of characters to put in the file name.

notificationMode.name: Show notification when renaming manually
notificationMode.desc: When to show notifications for manual rename commands.

desc.part1: If a note starts with a card link created with
desc.part3: , the card link title will be put in the file name.

newNoteDelay.name: New note delay
newNoteDelay.desc: Delay renaming new notes by this amount in milliseconds. May resolve issues on note creation.

contentReadMethod.name: Content read method
contentReadMethod.desc: How the plugin reads note content. Cache or file read may resolve issues but will be slower.

checkInterval.name: Check interval
checkInterval.desc: The interval in milliseconds for checking first-line changes. Increase it in case of issues.

debug.name: Debug
debug.desc: Log all of the plugin's activity to the developer console.

debugOutputFullContent.name: Output full file content in console
debugOutputFullContent.desc: Log the complete content of files (including properties) whenever they are modified.

backupSettings.name: Back up and restore
backupSettings.desc: Export plugin settings, or import from a backup.

clearSettings.name: Clear settings
clearSettings.desc: Reset all First Line is Title settings to default.

titleCase.name: Title case
titleCase.desc: Transform the case of the title when renaming.
